# PGlove

> PGlove is a free, open-source, themeable browser for Windows built on a real Tauri 2 and Rust core with per-tab WebView2 isolation. No telemetry, no analytics, no tracking, no paid tier. Licensed BSD 3-Clause. Made in India for the world, for next zen internet exploration. Stable release v1.0.3.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://pglove.jo3.org/): The whole product in one page — features, downloads, ecosystem, team, credits and support.
- [v1.0.4 Archive](https://pglove.jo3.org/v1.0.4/): The archived Pokemon-themed release, with 151 hand-drawn 8-bit icons and type-based colour schemes. Permanently available with its source.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pglove.jo3.org/privacy/): What PGlove collects (nothing), third-party services, cookies, and your data rights.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://pglove.jo3.org/terms/): BSD 3-Clause licence, acceptable use, intellectual property, warranty disclaimer and liability.
- [Security Policy](https://pglove.jo3.org/security.txt): Disclosure contact and supported versions, per RFC 9116.
- [robots.txt](https://pglove.jo3.org/robots.txt): Crawler policy.

## Features

- [Features](https://pglove.jo3.org/#features): Real Tauri 2 core, per-tab isolation, themeable engine, no telemetry, runs on 4 GB RAM.
- [Extensions](https://pglove.jo3.org/#extensions): Theme layer explained — Pokemon, Minecraft, GTA 6 and Vice City.
- [Nexa Search](https://pglove.jo3.org/#nexa): Search the web, find the signal. Search integration built by the same team.

## Releases

- [Roadmap](https://pglove.jo3.org/roadmap.html): Every version, what it did, what happened to it, and why v1.0.5–1.0.7 are paused pending funding.
- [Download](https://pglove.jo3.org/#download): Stable v1.0.3 via NPM, NuGet, Winget (pending), itch.io and the Internet Archive.

## Facts

- Author: Aditya Kumar Sethi (TechAdityaBRO), with BRO GANG and D1M Studios.
- Stack: Tauri 2, Rust, WebView2. Runs on Windows 10 or later, 64-bit.
- Developed on 4 GB RAM, Tiny 10 LTSC, Intel UHD Graphics 600 and an Intel Celeron — small hardware can make big changes.
- Pokémon and all related trademarks, characters and imagery belong to The Pokémon Company. PGlove is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
